verdict.rationale: Cekura ships an official CLI and SDK for managing agents, scenarios, runs, and call data, plus an MCP server/skills specifically designed so an AI assistant can design, run, and improve voice-agent evaluations, backed by a documented OpenAPI spec. Together these give an AI-native user a programmatic path to create eval datasets (scenarios), trigger runs, and read back results. Missing for 10: a concrete end-to-end worked example/transcript showing an agent doing all three steps in sequence, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of this specific programmatic workflow.
